statements.subject: server
statements.description: When a server receives a DHCPDISCOVER message from a client, the server chooses a network address for the requesting client. Once the network address and lease have been determined, the server constructs a DHCPOFFER message with the offered configuration parameters and sends the DHCPOFFER message to the requesting client.
actions: insert xid from DHCPDISCOVER into DHCPOFFER xid field

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If no address is available, the server may choose to report the problem to the system administrator.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A server MAY, for administrative reasons, assign an address other than the one requested, or may refuse to allocate an address to a particular client even though free addresses are available.
actions: refuse to allocate address to client

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server SHOULD NOT reuse the selected network address before the client responds to the server's DHCPOFFER message. The server may choose to record the address as offered to the client.
actions: record address as offered to client
do not reuse selected network address until client responds
